evidence: Valid arithmetic and one malicious sample are accurately reported; broad assertion about entire tool grammar and inability to express any code-execution payload goes beyond these observations. General capability boundary not established by its evidence.
Usable Python/OWASP advice includes restricted grammar, bounds, isolation and generic errors.

Pow limit is checked only when right operand is ast.Constant. Its explicitly promised rejection of9**9**9**9 does not occur during validation because outer exponents are BinOp; _evaluate then calls operator.pow on them. Thus the claimed exponent protection and included rejection test are contradicted by the code. No large exponent or generated code executed.
